color-contrast (light).note: Measured 2026-08-11, after the sidebar badge moved onto its calibrated pairing (one route fewer in each theme). Three causes remain. (1) WCAG-exempt inactive controls axe cannot recognise, because `disabled` sits on a custom element: `<wr-btn disabled>` labels and the disabled switch / checkbox labels (those use `--wr-color-on-surface-muted` correctly; it just happens to equal the `medium` intent in the dark theme). (2) `wr-squircle--bordered` — an ARTEFACT, not a defect: the content background is painted by a `::before` pseudo-element, which no DOM background walker can see, so axe falls back to the host's background-color — the BORDER colour — and compares the intent against itself. The real pairing there is ink-on-white at ~5.9:1. (3) `wr-calendar__day--out-of-month` at 2.23:1, which was listed under (1) until `check:state-contrast` measured it: those cells are ENABLED buttons reachable with the arrow keys, so the exemption never applied. The colour is fine (#5f6c7d, 4.63:1 on white) and `opacity: 0.55` is what drops it — see `state-contrast-baseline.json` for why tuning that number cannot fix it. (4) The swatch grid on /guides/tokens/colors, which labels every shade of a ramp with `{intent}-contrast`, a token calibrated for the base shade only.

color-contrast (dark).note: The same causes as the light entry, on the pages where the dark theme also lands under 4.5.

target-size (light).note: Two components, both design calls rather than defects to patch quietly. (1) `wr-carousel`'s pagination dots — 8x8 CSS px with centres 14px apart (the active dot is 20x8). WCAG 2.5.8 wants 24x24 targets, or undersized ones whose 24px circles do not intersect; 14px centres fail both. (2) `wr-event-calendar`'s event chips — 20px tall, measured 2026-08-11. Raising them to 24 fits one fewer event per month cell before the overflow indicator appears, which is a density decision about the component rather than a bug. The spacing exception does not rescue either one: stacked chips sit closer than 24px apart, so their circles overlap. The `touch-target` mixin does not help either — it is gated on `@media (pointer: coarse)`, and 2.5.8 applies to every pointer.

target-size (dark).note: The same two components and the same measurements as the light entry — neither is themed.
